title: Classic Spaghetti Bolognese
description: A rich and hearty Italian meat sauce served over al dente spaghetti, perfect for a comforting family dinner.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Sauté onion until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, oregano, and basil.
Season with salt and pepper. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
Serve the sauce over spaghetti, topped with Parmesan.

title: Fluffy Blueberry Pancakes
description: Light, fluffy pancakes bursting with fresh blueberries — the perfect weekend breakfast treat.
steps: Whisk together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
In another bowl, beat egg, then mix in milk and melted butter.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed (lumps are okay).
Gently fold in blueberries.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form, then flip.
Cook until golden brown. Serve with maple syrup.

title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
description: Creamy mashed avocado on toasted sourdough, topped with a perfectly poached egg and a sprinkle of chili flakes.
steps: Toast the sourdough slices until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer, add vinegar.
Crack eggs into small bowls and gently slide into the water.
Poach eggs for 3-4 minutes until whites are set.
Spread avocado on toast, top with poached egg.
Sprinkle with chili flakes and herbs.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Crisp romaine lettuce with grilled chicken, crunchy croutons, and a tangy Caesar dressing.
steps: Season chicken with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill chicken over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Tear romaine into bite-sized pieces.
Toss romaine with Caesar dressing.
Top with chicken slices, croutons, and Parmesan.

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Individual warm chocolate cakes with a gooey molten center — an indulgent dessert that never fails to impress.
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Butter and dust 4 ramekins with cocoa.
Melt chocolate and butter together in a double boiler.
Whisk eggs, yolks, and sugar until pale and thick.
Fold chocolate mixture into egg mixture.
Sift in flour and fold gently.
Divide batter among ramekins. Refrigerate up to 24 hours or bake immediately.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until edges are set but center jiggles.
Run a knife around edges and invert onto plates. Serve immediately with ice cream.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: A quick and colorful mix of fresh vegetables tossed in a savory soy-ginger sauce, served over steamed rice.
steps: Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch, and 2 tbsp water for the sauce.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add harder vegetables (carrot, broccoli) first; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add remaining vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Pour sauce over vegetables and toss until thickened.
Serve over steamed rice.
